snippet.title: Trivial Pursuit Live! - Official Launch Trailer | 2015 Xbox One Game HD
snippet.description:
Watch the Trivial Pursuit Live! Official Launch Trailer. This 2015 Xbox One/Xbox 360 game is now available.

Subscribe to XboxViewTV Video Game Trailers ► http://bit.ly/1pMsoAA

Please don't forget to LIKE, SHARE and COMMENT this! THANK YOU!
----------------------------------------
Trivial Pursuit Live! Now Available for Xbox.

A modern twist on the world’s most well-known trivia game. Play with your knowledge in a fast paced TV Show experience. A modern look, new reinvented question types, and the world’s best questions from the world’s top trivia authority. The game is now more fun and inclusive for everyone through adapted difficulty levels and unique catch-up rounds that inject social moments offering players a fresh, original experience.Trivia has never been so much fun.

Purchase Trivial Pursuit Live! for Xbox One from the Xbox Games Store: https://store.xbox.com/Xbox-One/Games/TRIVIAL-PURSUIT-LIVE/4f54dc21-378e-46d3-b408-a921c13ccd8b?cid=majornelson

Purchase Trivial Pursuit Live! for Xbox 360 from the Xbox Games Store: http://marketplace.xbox.com/Product/Trivial-Pursuit-Live/66acd000-77fe-1000-9115-d8025841145b?DownloadType=Game#LiveZone?cid=majornelson
